_comment: Ground truth from Factorio 2.1.23 (build 87750, linux64, headless) for the FULL enemy_base_probability on Nauvis (the game's own named expression: the spot-noise core plus the blob terms, the starting-area term and the -0.3 offset). Two seeds, 123456 and 777771, each forced onto a create_surface() surface. Positions are a 128 x 128 grid, x = x0 + pitch * (i % n), y = y0 + pitch * (i // n), in row-major order. `full` is the game's value at every position. `full45` is the same expression text redefined with suggested_minimum_candidate_point_spacing = 45.254833995939045; it is stored sparsely as [index, value] pairs for the positions where it differs from `full`, and equals `full` everywhere else. Regenerate: python3 -I scripts/probes/enemy-spot-spacing/capture.py <2.1.23 headless install>
